label: رسمي
note: Primary: Blizzard News 'World of Warcraft: Forever Goes Live Globally November 4!' (29 Oct 2026) and the BlizzCon announcement article 24302093, both read in full 22:00Z: launches globally November 4, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. PST (23:00Z, 03:00 Dubai on 5 Nov); access included with a WoW Subscription or Game Time; more than 1,000 new quests across levels 1 to 60; nine new five-player dungeons (levels 13 to 60); new playable Skyborne race; raids open December 9. Footage: BlizzCon 2026 gameplay trailer, IGN official MP4 1920x1080 60 fps, full frame. Shots chosen clear of the trailer's burnt-in feature labels and title words. Sound: the trailer's music from 43.0 s; its narration runs 1 to 40 s and is not used. pace_ok: each shot is a trailer stretch with its own cuts (13.9-16.85 cut at 15.3; 28.75-33.35 cut at 31.7; 74.4-78.3 cut at 77.3).
